observations: M3_R10:444 says 'U1.15 / U1.17 pitch 0.200 mm'; 0.200 mm is the pad edge-to-edge gap (measured U1.15-U1.16 0.2001 mm), U1's pitch is 0.5 mm. The wording is loose, but no figure or procedure depends on it.

M3_R10:444 gives the ACT_EN_MCU-to-NRST via (24.3,49.1) at 0.425 mm (measured 0.4248 mm) and its effect on ACT_EN only (at most 0.22 V). A bridge would also pull NRST low whenever PC1 drives low, which would reset-loop the MCU. That is fail-safe and diagnosable (no bus enable, no fire), and leaving it out makes no statement false.

M3_R10 'Option for the owner' quotes 'R121 x C120 = 10 ms time constant'. The Thevenin constant with R119 || R120 is about 8.3 ms; the product as written is arithmetically true and sits in a not-adopted option.
PC8 detection (obligation 28) uses Table 157's tested VIH of 0.7 VDD; the by-design 0.47 VDD + 0.25 V line would recognise 2.20 V. The stated threshold is the conservative one, not a false one.

Rule 4's 0.96 x VLOGIC-derived band: Q120's body diode at the about 1.8 mA ground bus load is about 0.51 V at 25 C and about 0.32 V at 125 C (AONR21357 Fig. 6 p3), so discrimination depends on temperature and on the VLOGIC drop. Round 29 already ruled this covered by 'Qualify the band on first articles'; nothing new.
Rule 4's 0.93-1.01x / >= 1.39x / >= 1.04x ratios are the round 23 envelope (1.043-1.137 A), not the two quoted currents; R27 triage already ruled this conservative.

Table 120 (DS12110 Rev 8 p213) allows no injection at all (-0/0) on PA4 and PA5; both are open-drain status inputs pulled to 3V3 by R91 / R89 10 kOhm, with no source that goes below VSS or above VDD, so no violation.
